groups.B: Regressions - half-right multi-select (one pick correct, second wrong)
groups.C: Regressions - one detail decides (storage class, update mechanism)

1.keywords: on-premises database; page load latency; quickly and cost-effectively; Spot EC2 behind ALB; reduce latency
1.trap: 🔁 Picked B: Aurora migration via DMS/SCT is slow and costly, engine support not guaranteed. Question wants quick, cheap fix; ElastiCache in VPC cuts trips to on-prem DB.
1.rule: DB latency plus quick and cost-effective: add ElastiCache cache in front of DB; do not migrate the database.

40.keywords: strict RPO/RTO; highly available fault-tolerant; Route 53 record type pointing to ELB; Aurora Replicas
40.trap: 🔁 Picked B: CNAME to ELB is wrong. Route 53 must use an Alias record for ELB; ElastiCache and four AZs do not fix the record type.
40.rule: All options look highly available: the Route 53 record decides. Point to ELB with Alias, not A record or CNAME.

41.keywords: Aurora 40 TB; RTO 30 minutes; RPO 5 minutes; stateless web/app tiers; cost-effective; Select TWO
41.trap: 🔁 Picked A and D: D right, but hot-standby web/app tier is not cost-effective. Stateless tiers only need daily EBS snapshot copied cross-Region; 30-minute RTO is enough.
41.rule: Stateless tiers: cheap cross-Region snapshot copy. Aurora data tier: cross-Region read replica for RPO, promote on disaster.

56.keywords: fully managed; encryption at rest and in transit; own key rotated; highly durable; Redshift Spectrum
56.trap: 🔁 Picked B: File Gateway adds management overhead, and SSE-S3 keys are AWS-managed not customer-controlled. Direct S3 with SSE-KMS plus HTTPS-only policy fits better.
56.rule: Fully managed, customer key, durable: S3 with SSE-KMS and bucket policy denying aws:SecureTransport false.

62.keywords: Redshift DR; KMS-encrypted cluster; recovery site 500 miles away; cross-region snapshot; snapshot copy grant
62.trap: 🔁 Picked B: custom CloudFormation plus S3 replication is not the Redshift-native way. KMS keys are Region-specific, so encrypted cross-Region copy needs a snapshot copy grant.
62.rule: KMS-encrypted Redshift cross-Region snapshot copy: create snapshot copy grant for destination-Region key first.

34.keywords: SSE-C; Select TWO; presigned URLs; REST API headers; data in transit
34.trap: Picked A and E: A right, but for presigned URLs the algorithm header is x-amz-server-side-encryption-customer-algorithm, not the key-MD5 header. B was the correct second pick.
34.rule: SSE-C: REST calls need algorithm, key, key-MD5 headers; presigned URLs specify the customer-algorithm header. HTTPS required.

47.keywords: tags always added at creation; centralized provisioning tools; infrastructure-as-code templates; AWS Organization; Select TWO
47.trap: Picked C and E: C right, but AWS-generated cost allocation tags in Billing are not proactive tagging at creation. Service Catalog tags provisioned resources automatically, so A was needed.
47.rule: Proactive tag-on-create: CloudFormation Resource Tags plus Service Catalog. Config only detects; Billing tags do not enforce.

38.keywords: 200 TB shared file system; monthly 72-hour job; reduce storage cost; S3 plus FSx for Lustre lazy-loading
38.trap: Picked C: S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval suits archive data accessed about once a quarter, not monthly processing. S3 Intelligent-Tiering plus temporary FSx for Lustre was right.
38.rule: Monthly batch on huge data: S3 Intelligent-Tiering for storage, temporary FSx for Lustre linked to S3, delete after the job.

68.keywords: CloudFormation AMI update; no downtime; UpdateStack replaces instances; AutoScalingGroup UpdatePolicy
68.trap: Picked B: change set only previews changes and does not deploy instances. Zero-downtime AMI rollout needs an UpdatePolicy with AutoScalingRollingUpdate on the AutoScalingGroup.
68.rule: Replace ASG instances with new AMI without downtime: UpdatePolicy AutoScalingRollingUpdate on AutoScalingGroup, not change set or new stack.
